summary: Frontend-only wiring verification for iter31 — RetroPayPanel + MoFSignaturesButton wiring and PostJobModal extraction. All three integrations work end-to-end. Existing Civil-Service tabs and Payroll actions regress cleanly. 0 real console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: MoFSignatures modal empty-state message 'No signatures yet. This run is awaiting the first MoF approver.' is shown even when mof_status is 'approved' via the legacy single-sig flow (mof-approve endpoint that doesn't populate signatures[]). Not a regression from this iteration (the component was not modified now) but the wording is misleading for legacy approved runs. Consider showing a different message when data.mof_status === 'approved' but data.signatures.length === 0 (e.g., 'This run was approved via the legacy single-signature flow.').

Gov tenant currently has 22 draft + 3 approved payroll runs; no submitted/partially_signed/rejected exist. Multi-signature button visibility for 'submitted'/'partially_signed'/'rejected' statuses was verified via component logic ({submitted/partially_signed/approved/rejected}.includes(mofStatus)) but not exercised with a live-status row. E1 may want to seed one of each status for richer UI coverage.

React devtool overlay injects <span data-ve-dynamic=true> inside <option> elements (visible in DOM in the RetroPayPanel employee dropdown), causing a hydration console warning. This is from the emergent tooling, NOT the app code — flagging for awareness only.
test_credentials: admin@gov.sl / GovAdmin@2026 (gov tenant admin, mof_approver=true, no 2FA) — worked as expected
seed_data_creation: Created 1 retro-pay adjustment (SDET employee, +250 SLE, current period 2026-07, source=manual) and 1 job posting titled 'SDET Test Job 1374512' via UI. Both appeared successfully in their respective lists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter31 wiring is verified working. RetroPayPanel: 7 filter chips + form modal + all 6 testids (retro-emp/monthly/from/to/source/reason) work; POST /civil-service/retro-pay creates row; MoFSignaturesButton auto-hides for mof_status='draft' and shows for approved (only status available in gov tenant seed); modal has progress bar, list/empty state, close; sign actions correctly hidden when status != submitted/partially_signed. PostJobModal: all testids present (post-job/post-job-modal/title/department/location/salary-min/salary-max/description/cancel/submit/close); creates posting and closes cleanly on submit/cancel/X. All 7 civil-service tabs and 25 payroll rows render fine. If richer MoF multi-sig UI testing is needed, first submit a draft run via Submit-to-MoF button to get a 'submitted' status, then the Sign approval / Sign reject buttons will render.
